note: Pilot: one floor tile, the north wall and a crate, to settle the look before the other 19 files. Round 2 (2026-10-28): the crate is #3; the floor and wall rerun lighter, since at 0.35+ they drew objects into the tile.

floor_tile.prompt: dark wooden floorboards seen from directly above, long horizontal planks, worn dark oak, a few nail heads
floor_tile.negativeExtra: objects, machinery, gears, pipes, brackets, plates, symbols

wall_segment_nw.prompt: the back wall of a workshop seen from the front, dark red-brown brick above a wooden wainscot panel and skirting
wall_segment_nw.negativeExtra: objects, machinery, door, lamp, sconce, window, sign, pipes, pillar

prop_crate.prompt: a wooden storage crate with brass corner brackets, seen from the front and slightly above, plain green background
